name: The Forest
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Survive a plane crash in a forest full of cannibals, alone or with friends. Installs the Windows dedicated server with SteamCMD, runs it under Wine and keeps it updated.
startup: winetricks -q sound=disabled >/dev/null 2>&1; wine ./TheForestDedicatedServer.exe -batchmode -nographics -nosteamclient -serverPasswordAdmin "{{ADMIN_PASS}}" -savefolderpath /home/container/TheForestDedicatedServer_Data -configfilepath /home/container/TheForestDedicatedServer_Data/forest/config/config.cfg > >(trap '' INT; exec grep --line-buffered -v 'RenderTexture.Create failed') 2>&1

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# The Forest. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 556450) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously (the Windows version, run under Wine).
# Saves and config.cfg are never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-556450}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The server reads config.cfg. One is written when there's none; the Panel
# sets the name, passwords, ports and game settings in it at every start,
# and the rest is the owner's.
cfg=TheForestDedicatedServer_Data/forest/config/config.cfg
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$cfg")"
if [ ! -f "$cfg" ]; then
    cat > "$cfg" <<'EOF'
// The Forest's dedicated server settings. The Panel sets the address, ports,
// name, player count, password, token, VAC, difficulty, start type and
// save slot at every start; the rest is yours.
serverIP 0.0.0.0
serverSteamPort 8766
serverGamePort 27015
serverQueryPort 27016
serverName
serverPlayers 8
serverPassword
serverSteamAccount
enableVAC off
serverAutoSaveInterval 15
difficulty Normal
initType Continue
slot 1
showLogs off
serverContact
veganMode off
vegetarianMode off
resetHolesMode off
treeRegrowMode off
allowBuildingDestruction on
allowEnemiesCreativeMode off
allowCheats off
saveFolderPath
targetFpsIdle 5
targetFpsActive 60
EOF
    echo "Made config.cfg."
fi
for key in serverIP serverSteamPort serverGamePort serverQueryPort serverName serverPlayers serverPassword serverSteamAccount enableVAC difficulty initType slot; do
    grep -q "^$key\( \|\$\)" "$cfg" || echo "$key" >> "$cfg"
done
echo "Installed The Forest build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password that gives a player admin commands in game.

variables.name: Server token
variables.description: A Steam game server login token for app 242760, which the server needs to keep players' progress.

variables.name: Start
variables.description: Continue loads the save slot, or starts a new game when it's empty; New starts over every time.

variables.name: Save slot
variables.description: Which of the five save slots the server uses.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Steam port
variables.description: The port the server talks to Steam on; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Windows install
variables.description: Install the Windows version of the server, which runs under Wine.

variables.name: Wine debug
variables.description: What Wine logs; -all keeps its messages out of the console.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
